payload.core_composition_summary: Combine bit pigeonhole check for large n with Floyd-Warshall complete search for small n to find shortest cycle.
payload.rationale: If n>128, answer 3 by bit representation; else run O(n^3) triple loops (Floyd-Warshall) to compute minimal cycle.
